'''Cavetroopers''' were a variant of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who were trained to operate in various cave-like geographical areas. They used a lighter version of [[Armor/Legends|armor]], similar to that of [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] and carried [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] and long-bladed [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknives]].

A unit of cavetroopers were part of the rapid reaction force on [[Phemis]] under the command of [[Ironarm]], guarding the forbidden [[rubat]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]].

==Behind the scenes==
The cavetroopers appear in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure, ''[[Hidden Depths]]''.
